acquisition method: MS data were acquired using a data-dependent top 12 method
alkylation reagent: The reduced cysteines were alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3 for 45 min in the dark
alkylation concentration: The reduced cysteines were alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide in 100 mM NH4HCO3 for 45 min in the dark
cleavage agent: the digestion buffer containing Sequencing grade Trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) in 20 mM ammonium bicarbonate
collision energy: For HCD spectra resolution was set to 35000, AGC target 1e5, IT 120 ms; normalized collision energy 25% and isolation width of 3.0 m/z.
fractionation method: The second SDS-PAGE was stained with colloidal blue and putative bands at the same molecular weight as the blotting, were cut and examined by nLC-MS/MS analysis
fragmentation method: For HCD spectra resolution was set to 35000
instrument: Of them, 3 μl were injected on a quadrupole Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) coupled with an UHPLC Easy-nLC 1000 (Thermo Scientific)
labeling: The second SDS-PAGE was stained with colloidal blue and putative bands at the same molecular weight as the blotting, were cut and examined by nLC-MS/MS analysis
reduction reagent: Disulfide bridges were reduced using 10 mM DTT in 100 mM NH4HCO3 for 1 h at 56°C.
reduction concentration: Disulfide bridges were reduced using 10 mM DTT in 100 mM NH4HCO3 for 1 h at 56°C.
